description: Réseaux de transports en commun de la Métropole d'Aix-Marseille-Provence et des Bouches-du-Rhône is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Métropole d'Aix-Marseille-Provence. The Metropolis of Aix-Marseille-Provence is opening its public data "Transport" in order to promote the emergence of applications in the field. You will find a set of files containing the complete description of the lines of the different partner networks in NEPTUNE standard XML format and in GTFS format. Coverage: Métropole d'Aix-Marseille-Provence. The portal shows the English title as "Public transport networks of the Metropolis of Aix-Marseille-Provence and Bouches-du-Rhône" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Métropole d'Aix-Marseille-Provence. Its keywords include transports-en-commun, transport, reseaux, bus, car, marseille. The listing shows 6 download or service links in XML, ZIP, SIRI. The listing shows 2026-04-01 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
